alt.en: Red key full stop uses IDs 270,32,268,32,46. The Chinese character zhong uses UTF-8 byte IDs 228,184,173. Concatenation restores the original bytes, then strict UTF-8 decoding restores the string. Byte FF from generated ID 255 has no valid standalone UTF-8 decoding.
alt.zh-hans: red key . 使用 ID 270、32、268、32、46。汉字中使用 UTF-8 字节 ID 228、184、173。先拼接还原原字节，再严格按 UTF-8 解码，才能还原原文。生成 ID 255 的字节 FF 无法独立解码为合法 UTF-8。

flow.en: Three tokens for one code point; do not decode each token alone.
